To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) specialised tools including clone detectors and plagiarism detectors outperform general similarity analysers such as string matching; (2) these specialised tools fail to locate similar artefacts from large code bases; (3) we propose a hybrid search system that is able to find similar code artefacts in large code corpora; and (4) our proposed system is resilient to incomplete and partial code fragments.
• The best similarity analysis tools for source code are specialised tools such as clone detectors and plagiarism detectors, when they are tuned for their purpose.
• We have evaluated 30 similarity analysing tools for source code and show that specialised tools, with proper parameter settings, outperform general tools such as string matching tools.
